marks.gloss_en: ולא היא, דהא קחזינן דלא הוי כולי האי: it is not so, for we see that it is not that much
the Rabbis of Caesarea: a circle inside a square [falls short of it by] a quarter; a square inside a circle [falls short by] a half -- so twenty-four is the circle around a sixteen-amah square
לאתויי סוכת רקב"ש -- דתנו רבנן: סוכת רועים, סוכת קייצים, סוכת בורגנין, סוכת שומרי פירות ... כשרה (kind tanya_kevatei stands in for a bare דתנו רבנן citation)
what does 'of any sort' [in the גנב"ך baraita] include? the רקב"ש booths
ואמאי? תהוי חיצונה כבית שער הפנימית, ותתחייב במזוזה: let the outer booth be the inner one's gatehouse and be obligated in mezuzah
משום דלא קביע: because it is not fixed
two potters' booths, one inside the other: the inner one is not a sukkah
a booth of gentiles, of women, of animals, of Kutim, a booth of any sort -- valid
what is 'in the proper way'? Rav Chisda: provided he made it for the shade of a sukkah
what does 'of any sort' [in the רקב"ש baraita] include? the גנב"ך booths
the גנב"ך tanna: those are the stronger case to him because they are fixed; he teaches 'of any sort' to include רקב"ש, which are not fixed
the רקב"ש tanna: those are the stronger case to him because [their makers] are obligated; he teaches 'of any sort' to include גנב"ך, whose makers are not
